items.new: 39-section omnibus (AEDT/employment AI incl. WARN-notice AI disclosure, companion chatbots, provenance, social media, regulatory sandbox). Frontier-relevant sections: frontier developers may not retaliate against covered employees reporting catastrophic-risk concerns or adopt contracts barring such reporting (effective Oct. 1, 2026); large frontier developers must operate anonymous internal reporting channels by Jan. 1, 2027, with quarterly sharing of reports with officers and directors; frontier developers must give covered employees notice of their rights; civil penalty up to $1,000 per violation of subsections (b) to (d), in an AG action in Hartford superior court, with state recovery of investigation costs and attorneys' fees when prevailing; plus a DCP-run IVO pilot through June 30, 2030 — see Section C.
items.note: self-correction (omission): The penalty covers all of subsections (b) to (d), including the employee-notice duty, not only the whistleblower duties, and the state can recover investigation costs and attorneys' fees. The entry also ends with a 'does not contain' statement, which the rules forbid. Quote: "Any frontier developer that violates any provision of subsections"
